map.三相总电流 = 总功率 / (√3 × 电压 × 功率因数)；单相设备电流 =: Three-phase total current = total power / (√3 × voltage × power factor); single-phase equipment current = power / (voltage × power factor). Three-phase loads must be split evenly across the three phases before adding the single-phase circuits.
map.为什么建议总负载不超过断路器 80%？: Why keep total load below 80% of the circuit breaker?
map.留裕度可应对灯具启动冲击与温升，降低跳闸与线路过热风险；长期满负荷会加速绝缘老化: The margin absorbs lamp inrush and temperature rise, reducing the risk of tripping and overheating; long-term full load accelerates insulation ageing.

map.舞台灯光负载与配电计算: Stage Lighting Load & Power Distribution Calculation
map.三相总电流 = 总功率 ÷ (√3 × 380V × 功率因数)（A）: Three-phase total current = total power ÷ (√3 × 380 V × power factor) (A)
map.单相总电流 = 总功率 ÷ (220V × 功率因数)（A）: Single-phase total current = total power ÷ (220 V × power factor) (A)
map.380V 每相平均电流 = 三相负载÷(√3×380×pf)÷3 + 单相负载÷: 380 V average current per phase = three-phase load ÷ (√3×380×pf) ÷ 3 + single-phase load ÷ (220×pf)
map.安全功率 = 总功率 × (1 + 安全裕度%): Safe power = total power × (1 + safety margin %)
map.安全电流 = 总电流 × (1 + 安全裕度%): Safe current = total current × (1 + safety margin %)
map.建议断路器 = ⌈安全电流 ÷ 16⌉ × 16（A，按 16A 模数取整）: Suggested breaker = ⌈safe current ÷ 16⌉ × 16 (A, rounded up to a 16 A step)
map.单相占比 = 单相功率 ÷ 总功率 × 100%: Single-phase share = single-phase power ÷ total power × 100%
map.舞台灯光总功率与负载计算器，根据灯具数量和功率计算总功率、电流及三相负载分配。: Stage lighting total power and load calculator that computes total wattage, current, and three-phase load distribution from fixture count and wattage.
map.380V 三相负载线电流 = 三相负载÷(√3×380×pf)（每相相同，不再÷: 380V three-phase line current = three-phase load ÷ (√3 × 380 × pf), identical on each phase (do not divide by 3); single-phase current = single-phase load ÷ (220 × pf); worst-phase current = three-phase line current + total single-phase current (assuming all single-phase load on one phase).
map.初步断路器 = 标准额定值中不小于“最不利相安全裕度后电流”的最小档；另给出负载: Preliminary breaker = the smallest standard rating not less than the worst-phase current after margin; also show the rating for load ≤ 80% of rating (A). Applicability still requires checking cable ampacity, protection and starting surge.
map.单相占比 = 单相功率 ÷ 总功率 × 100%（仅单相负载时同样有效）: Single-phase share = single-phase power ÷ total power × 100% (also valid with single-phase load only).
map.单相总电流 = 单相负载 / (220V × 功率因数)；三相线电流 = 三相负: Total single-phase current = single-phase load / (220V × power factor); three-phase line current = three-phase load / (√3 × 380V × power factor). Distribute three-phase load evenly, keeping phase imbalance within 15%. Keep total load below 80% of the breaker rating.
map.演出前汇总各灯具功率与数量，算总功率、三相线电流、单相电流与最不利相电流，再校核: Before the show, total fixture wattage and quantities, compute total power, three-phase line current, single-phase current and worst-phase current, then check supply capacity.
map.按最不利相电流预留安全裕度（如 20%），对照标准额定值给初步参考；线缆、保护与: Reserve a safety margin (e.g. 20%) on the worst-phase current and compare with standard ratings for a preliminary reference; cable, protection and starting surge require separate checks—do not treat it as final selection.
map.0.9、安全裕度 20% 计：三相均衡等效总电流 ≈ 51.3 A；若单相全集中: at power factor 0.9 and 20% margin: balanced three-phase equivalent total current ≈ 51.3 A; if all single-phase load is on one phase, worst phase ≈ 78.2 A, about 93.9 A after margin, preliminary standard rating 100 A (125 A if also applying the 80% limit); single-phase share ≈ 26.3%.
map.三相线电流 = 三相负载 / (√3 × 380V × 功率因数)；单相总电流: Three-phase line current = three-phase load / (√3 × 380V × power factor); total single-phase current = single-phase load / (220V × power factor). These are different bases; for mixed load, verify the worst-phase sum.
